messages:
Maria D.: quick check - small ux change proposal for the playground schema editor and run history. Main asks: inline validation UX, insert-example flow, compact badges in history, and accessible toasts. Mock: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/insert-toast.png

AJ: Proposal: show inline validation as a subtle underline + error icon. Hover or focus opens a small tooltip with message and an "Apply fix" quick action. Keep it non-blocking for runs.

Samir: Copy: tooltip title should be "Schema warning" not just "Error". Insert-example button text: "Insert example" and toast text: "Example inserted into editor" (we should make toast announcement polite).

Lee: A11y: toast must use role=status and aria-live=polite. But we must not reannounce while typing. Use a short-lived live region and only announce on explicit insert. Also ensure toast has focusable action "Undo" for keyboard users.

DesignBot: Auto-scan: 2 issues flagged 1 - missing label on quick-action buttons, 1 - toast not using role=alert in current build. Full report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/1872000000

Nina: History badges: shrink to icon+tooltip, show count only for tool calls >1. Collapse long titles with ellipsis. Chevron remains first tab stop.

AJ: Implementation note: quick-action handlers should set editor focus and place cursor at start of inserted sample, then announce "Example inserted" through polite live region. Undo button should remove inserted text and announce "Example removed".

Maria D.: Action items:
- AJ: prototype inline validation + insert flow (due Thu)
- Lee: toast + announcement pattern PR (due Wed)
- Samir: copy pass + tooltip wording (small PR)
- Nina: compact-badge mock updates (due Fri)

AJ: I'll drop a tiny Loom of the flow when ready. Any other concerns?
